goal: 和同学确定新学期目标

n1.speaker: 同学 Mark
n1.line: Hi! The new semester has started. Do you have any plans to make this term different?
n1.lineCn: 嗨!新学期开始了。你有没有计划让这个学期有所不同?

grammar.name: 不定式表目的
grammar.note: plans to make... 动词不定式 to do 作定语,说明计划的内容。

options.text: Yes! I plan to study two hours every day and to read ten books this term.
options.textCn: 有!我打算每天学习两小时,这学期读十本书。
options.feedback: 用 plan to do 和 and to do 列出具体目标,非常明确。
没有目标,谈话很难深入。

n2.speaker: 同学 Mark
n2.line: Reading ten books is a great goal! To make it happen, you need a clear plan. How will you choose the books?
n2.lineCn: 读十本书是个很好的目标!要实现它,你需要清晰的计划。你打算怎么选书呢?

grammar.name: 不定式作目的状语
grammar.note: To make it happen 表目的,相当于 in order to,放在句首。

options.text: I decide to ask our teacher for advice, and I want to start with short novels.
options.textCn: 我决定向老师请教,想先从短篇小说读起。
options.feedback: 用 decide to do / want to do 说明具体做法,方案可行。

options.text: I do not know. It is too hard to choose.
options.feedback: 犹豫不决,目标还是停留在空话上。

n3.speaker: 同学 Mark
n3.line: Come on! Even a small goal is better than nothing. What is something you have always wanted to try?
n3.lineCn: 别这样!哪怕一个小目标也比没有强。你一直想尝试的是什么?

grammar.name: want to try
grammar.note: have always wanted to try... 用 want + to do 表达一直以来的心愿。

options.text: I want to learn to play the guitar. It has been my dream since I was a child.
options.textCn: 我想学弹吉他,这是我从小到大的梦想。
options.feedback: 说出了具体想做的事,目标有了方向。

options.text: I want to do nothing but sleep.
options.textCn: 我只想睡觉,什么都不想做。
options.feedback: 消极态度,让同学没法帮你。

n4.speaker: 同学 Mark
n4.line: Starting with short novels is a smart way to build a reading habit. It is important to keep going even when you are busy.
n4.lineCn: 从短篇小说入手是养成阅读习惯的聪明办法。再忙也要坚持下去,这很重要。

grammar.name: It is important to do...
grammar.note: It is + 形容词 + to do 结构,it 作形式主语,真正主语是不定式。

options.text: Exactly. I will try my best to finish one chapter every day, no matter how busy I am.
options.textCn: 没错。不管多忙,我都会尽力每天读一章。
options.feedback: 把目标拆成每天一章,还用了 try to do,计划落地。

options.text: Maybe I will give up if it gets too hard.
options.textCn: 要是太难,我可能会放弃。
options.feedback: 还没开始就想放弃,这样的目标很难实现。

n5.speaker: 同学 Mark
n5.line: Let us find an easy way. To be realistic, what is the smallest goal you can keep every day?
n5.lineCn: 我们找个简单点的办法。说实话,你每天能做到的最小目标是什么?

grammar.name: To be realistic
grammar.note: 不定式短语作独立成分,表示"说实在的",引出评价。

options.text: I can try to read ten pages a day. That is small enough to keep.
options.textCn: 我可以试着每天读十页。这个目标小到能坚持。
options.feedback: 把目标调整到可执行的范围,务实且可行。

options.text: I cannot decide. You choose for me.
options.textCn: 我决定不了,你替我想吧。
options.feedback: 自己的目标却让别人定,毫无主动性。

n6.speaker: 同学 Mark
n6.line: Great! Now we both have clear goals. I decide to run three times a week to stay healthy. Shall we check on each other every Friday?
n6.lineCn: 太好了!现在我们都有清晰的目标了。我决定每周跑三次步来保持健康。每周五我们互相监督怎么样?

grammar.name: 不定式表目的
grammar.note: to stay healthy 作目的状语,说明跑步的目的。

options.text: Good idea! I promise to share my reading progress with you every Friday.
options.textCn: 好主意!我答应每周五跟你分享我的阅读进度。
options.feedback: 爽快接受互相监督,还承诺定期汇报,目标确定!

options.text: I do not need anyone to check on me.
options.textCn: 我不需要任何人监督我。
options.feedback: 拒绝了同学的善意,目标可能很快就坚持不下去。

success.speaker: 同学 Mark
success.line: Deal! New semester, new goals. Let us work hard together!
success.lineCn: 说定了!新学期,新目标。我们一起努力吧!

fail1.speaker: 同学 Mark
fail1.line: Alright... I hope you find your goal soon. See you in class.
fail1.lineCn: 好吧……希望你早点找到目标。课堂见。

fail2.speaker: 同学 Mark
fail2.line: Suit yourself. But remember, goals are easier to keep when friends help.
fail2.lineCn: 随你吧。不过记住,有朋友帮忙,目标更容易坚持。
